comment: Blocked by dungeon.c print_dungeon(): the same unreachable dummy-letter choice as levtele-menu-endgame-dummy-letter, but reached through the m-prefixed ^V that skips getlin(). The zero identifier makes print_dungeon() read lchoices.playerlev[-1], an uninitialized stack byte. After the getlin() prompt the reference build reads 0 and level_tele() returns silently; without the prompt it reads a nonzero value here, and C prints "You can't get there from here." The port models the 0 case only, so this case does not match.
